documents.title: Annual report extract
documents.text:
Annual report extract: Hollins Software (fictional, authored test material).
Free cash flow at Hollins Software stood at $21.7m in FY2025 (reported basis). Hollins Software had gross debt of $351.6m in FY2025 (reported basis), as originally reported. For Hollins Oy, cash on balance sheet in FY2024 was $73.6m (reported basis). Operating expenses at Hollins Software stood at around $57m in FY2024 (reported basis).

documents.title: Quarterly lender update
documents.text:
Quarterly lender update: Hollins Software (fictional, authored test material).
Receivables in arrears at Hollins Software stood at 7.4% in FY2025, first issue. Hollins Nordic, a subsidiary had recurring revenue share of 88.6% in FY2025. For Hollins GmbH, cash on balance sheet in FY2024 was $59.1m (reported basis). Operating expenses at Hollins Software stood at $58.8m in FY2024 (reported basis).

documents.title: Independent business review
documents.text:
Independent business review: Hollins Software (fictional, authored test material).
Free cash flow at Hollins Software stood at $27.2m in FY2023 (reported basis). Hollins Software had gross debt of $308.3m in FY2025 (reported basis), as restated in the latest accounts. For Hollins Software, receivables in arrears in FY2025 was 5.3%, second issue (corrects the first issue). Recurring revenue share at Hollins Software stood at 79.2% in FY2025.
